title: 情報フロンティア大意(経営情報)
subtitle: Introduction to Informatics and Human Communication (Management Systems)
keywords: Disciplines of Faculty 2.Discipline of Department 3.Management 4.Innovation 5.Community Oriented
educationalGoal: This is an introductory course for first-year students in the Department of Management Systems. In the course, students will: (1) learn the disciplines of the Faculty of Informatics and Human Communication and the Department of Management Systems (2) develop career plans based on their vision of the future. (3) create a learning plan consistent with their career plans.
advice: This is an introductory course for incoming freshmen. Students will learn about the various disciplines and devise a plan for their future. Topics will include: 1) Disciplines of the Faculty and the Department: lectures from the Dean, the Department Head, and various professors. 2) Curriculum, education, and research of the Department of Management Systems. 3) Career plans: lectures from alumni, and an exercise in career planning. 4) Learning plans: lectures from the Head of the Department, and a planning exercise.
